title: Sending a Letter to Canada From the US
description: Mailing a letter from the US to Canada: the USPS Global Forever stamp at $1.75, what to check, and a way to send it without an international stamp.
keywords: mail a letter to canada from usa
how many stamps to mail from us to canada
answer: From the United States, USPS says stamps for a standard-sized letter up to one ounce start at $1.75 for all countries, and one Global Forever stamp, currently $1.75, never expires. Heavier, oversized or unusually shaped envelopes are priced by destination. Or order the letter online and have it printed and mailed inside Canada.

blocks.p: USPS's international letter page says a Global Forever stamp currently costs $1.75 and never expires, even if the price goes up, and that stamps for standard-sized letters up to 1 oz start at $1.75 for all countries. Heavier, oversized or unusually shaped items are priced by the destination's price group, which USPS lists on its Country Price Groups page.
USPS's page does not say whether ordinary domestic Forever stamps are valid for Canada, so use a Global Forever stamp, or ask your post office. USPS sells international stamps through its store.

ul: Weigh it. A letter over one ounce needs more postage.
Write the Canadian address in Canadian order, and add the country name as USPS instructs.

blocks.p: An online service can mail it from inside Canada, so it travels as ordinary Canadian Lettermail: 2 to 4 business days by Canada Post's standard once posted, an estimate and not a guarantee. sendletter's cheapest letter is $3.49 in Canadian dollars with printing, postage and tax included. It is untracked ordinary mail for Canadian addresses only.

ul: Writing the postal code as a ZIP code. A Canadian one is [letter-number-letter, number-letter-number](/blog/canadian-postal-code-format).
Leaving off the postal code. Canada Post's price guide says a missing or incorrect code is charged at higher rates, and the item may be undeliverable.
Forgetting a return address. See [why letters to Canada get returned](/blog/why-letters-to-canada-get-returned).
